title: setopt: reject CR and LF octets in curl_slists given to options
body:
All options accepting an slist now reject the list and return error if any item in the list points to a string that 
contains a CR or LF octet.

- [X] test this for all setopt options
- [ ] test error output for command line options passing in CRLF
- [ ] document
